license_required.quote: No person shall engage in plumbing or engage in or work at the trade of plumbing: (a) Unless he or she is the holder of a valid and effective active master plumber's license duly issued by the department

age_minimum.quote: Be at least eighteen (18) years of age

exams.name: Master Plumber Examination

exams.jurisdiction: state (Kentucky Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction)
exams.quote: no master or journeyman plumber's license shall be issued except upon a successful passage of an examination as prescribed by the department

interval_years.quote: Renewed licenses shall expire on the last day of the licensee's birth month of each year after the date of issuance of the renewed license.

required.quote: The department shall require an applicant for renewal of a license to show evidence of completing the continuing education requirements established by the department in administrative regulations

available.quote: The department may issue a license to any person who holds a valid license in another state if that state has a statewide plumbing code, the other state's examination is at least equal to that of Kentucky, and the other state agrees to reciprocate with Kentucky.

requirements.value: The other state must have a statewide plumbing code, an examination at least equal to Kentucky's, and must agree to reciprocate with Kentucky.
requirements.quote: The department may issue a license to any person who holds a valid license in another state if that state has a statewide plumbing code, the other state's examination is at least equal to that of Kentucky, and the other state agrees to reciprocate with Kentucky.

exists.quote: No amendment of the code or any other related administrative regulation shall be promulgated by the department without the prior review and comment of the Housing, Buildings and Construction Advisory Committee

name.value: Housing, Buildings and Construction Advisory Committee
name.quote: the prior review and comment of the Housing, Buildings and Construction Advisory Committee under the requirements of KRS 198B.030(8)

authority.value: review and comment on amendments to the plumbing code and related administrative regulations before promulgation
authority.quote: No amendment of the code or any other related administrative regulation shall be promulgated by the department without the prior review and comment of the Housing, Buildings and Construction Advisory Committee

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall engage in plumbing or engage in or work at the trade of plumbing: (a) Unless he or she is the holder of a valid and effective active master plumber's license duly issued by the department

credential_type.quote: No person shall engage in plumbing or engage in or work at the trade of plumbing: (a) Unless he or she is the holder of a valid and effective active master plumber's license duly issued by the department

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall engage in plumbing or engage in or work at the trade of plumbing: (a) Unless he or she is the holder of a valid and effective active master plumber's license duly issued by the department

title_protection.quote: No person shall advertise as or claim to be a licensed master or licensed journeyman plumber within the Commonwealth of Kentucky unless that person holds a master or journeyman plumber license from the department

scope_protection.quote: No person shall engage in plumbing or engage in or work at the trade of plumbing: (a) Unless he or she is the holder of a valid and effective active master plumber's license duly issued by the department in accordance with the provisions of this chapter; or (b) Unless he or she is the holder of a valid and effective journeyman plumber's license duly issued by the department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly violated the plumbing chapter, Kentucky State Plumbing Code, or department rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly violated this chapter, the Kentucky State Plumbing Code, or the rules and regulations of the department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced fraud or deception in applying for or obtaining a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced fraud or deception in applying for or obtaining a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetent to perform services as a licensed master plumber or licensed journeyman plumber
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incompetent to perform services as a licensed master plumber or a licensed journeyman plumber

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted license to be used directly or indirectly by another to obtain or perform plumbing work or services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted his or her license to be used directly or indirectly by another to obtain or perform plumbing work or services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of unprofessional or dishonorable conduct likely to deceive or defraud the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of other unprofessional or dishonorable conduct of a character likely to deceive or defraud the public

insurance_required.quote: No person, firm, or corporation shall engage in plumbing or engage in or work at the trade of plumbing unless the person, firm, or corporation maintains general liability insurance in an amount not less than two hundred fifty thousand dollars ($250,000)

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No person, firm, or corporation shall: (a) Construct, install, or alter, or cause to be constructed, installed, or altered, any plumbing without first having procured a plumbing installation permit therefor from the department

definition_quote.value: the art of installing in buildings the pipes for distributing the water supply, the fixtures for using water and drainage pipes for removing waste water and sewage, together with fittings, appurtenances, and appliances of various kinds, all within or adjacent to the building
definition_quote.quote: "Plumbing" means the art of installing in buildings the pipes for distributing the water supply, the fixtures for using water and drainage pipes for removing waste water and sewage, together with fittings, appurtenances, and appliances of various kinds, all within or adjacent to the building.

methods_authorized.quote: engages or offers to engage, either as an occupation or otherwise, in the construction, installation, alteration, maintenance, repair, remodeling or removal, and replacement of plumbing

license_tiers.quote: "Journeyman plumber" means a person who engages or offers to engage ... "Master plumber" means a person who assumes responsible charge ... "Apprentice" means a person in the process of learning the plumbing trade

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: An apprentice must work under the personal supervision of a licensed master or licensed journeyman plumber.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: "Apprentice" means a person in the process of learning the plumbing trade who assists and is under the personal supervision of a licensed master or licensed journeyman plumber

contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.value: master plumber required for general plumbing contractor
contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.quote: A company or individual principal may engage in the business of plumbing within any county of the Commonwealth if a person connected with that company or individual principal in responsible charge of the plumbing work is a licensed master plumber.

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: The department shall grant an interim period of up to one hundred eighty (180) continuous calendar days to allow a company to utilize the master plumber's license of a recently deceased owner or deceased employee
